theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (C : Set (Euclid n)), LipschitzWith L f → IsClosed C → (∀ x ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) C → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Set (Euclid n), A ⊆ C ∧ IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ Q : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < δ → ‖f y - f x - fderiv ℝ f x (y - x)‖ ≤ ε' * ‖y - x‖
